name: Brookit
title: Brook Kit
description: The water form of Vixi; ripples spread wherever it naps.
catchphrase: Splashes through crystal-clear mountain streams of stream data.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Sugar pebble candy that looks like river sea glass! Purring waves! 🍬💧
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Splashing crystal paws in morning mountain dew! So refreshing! 💧
companionPersonality.petReaction: Sends a playful splash of cool, invigorating stream mist to you! 💧💖

dialogue.idle: Floating on back in a clear stream, tail drifting like ribbon. 💧
dialogue.working: Keeping real-time streaming data flowing clear without eddies! 💧⚡
dialogue.thinking: Listening to the babble of the brook to detect flow blockage... 🤔
dialogue.success: CRYSTAL STREAM! Data flows clear all the way to the ocean! 💧🎉
dialogue.error: Dam blocked by fallen twig! Splashing hard to clear it! 🪵
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... resting in a calm river eddy under weeping willows... 🌙
